title: Enterprise Support: outcome precision and disposition for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — outcome precision and disposition for corrected-fee assessment.

## Decision basis

For corrected-fee assessment: Round the final nonnegative reviewed net support fee half up to two decimal places; the selected source tax treatment is US untaxed and reviewed signed tax amount is zero.

## Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: A hypothetical reviewed net fee of USD 123.455 rounds half up to USD 123.46. The reviewed tax is zero.
